candidate_schedule: exact B2.4 REP schedule, data, labels, optimizer, LR and batch construction

criteria.A_protection: mean cross-domain PREP-F0 change >= 0 in >=4/5 seeds
criteria.B_learning: mean local PREP-F0 change >= 0 in >=4/5 seeds
criteria.C_value: at least one exact domain x N structure has DeltaV_PREP(c) > 0 in >=4/5 seeds for every frozen c
criteria.D_integration: at least one frozen c x h cell has kappa_star > 0 in >=4/5 seeds
criteria.NULL: C_value is false AND D_integration is false
criteria.POSITIVE: A_protection AND B_learning AND C_value AND D_integration

rollback: model and optimizer restored exactly; scheduled RNG advances; no retry
